استقرضوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْرَضُوا (istaqraḍū) /is.taq.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اُسْتُقْرِضُوا (ustuqriḍū) /us.tuq.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اِسْتَقْرِضُوا (istaqriḍū) /is.taq.ri.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
